versions.subject: Merge PR #4463 from @citronninja - Add New Rules Related to VsCode Tunnel Usage & Abuse
versions.detection:
selection_only_tunnel:
    OriginalFileName: null
    CommandLine|endswith: '.exe tunnel'
selection_tunnel_args:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '.exe tunnel'
        - '--name '
        - '--accept-server-license-terms'
selection_parent_tunnel:
    ParentCommandLine|endswith: ' tunnel'
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/d /c '
        - '\servers\Stable-'
        - 'code-server.cmd'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (NOT OriginalFileName=* CommandLine="*.exe tunnel") OR (CommandLine="*.exe tunnel*" CommandLine="*--name *" CommandLine="*--accept-server-license-terms*") OR (ParentCommandLine="* tunnel" Image="*\\cmd.exe" CommandLine="*/d /c *" CommandLine="*\\servers\\Stable-*" CommandLine="*code-server.cmd*")
